python-2.7.base:
FROM python:2.7-slim-buster
RUN apt-get install bash

java.base:
FROM openjdk:8-jdk-alpine
RUN apk add bash
RUN apk add make
RUN apk add build-base
RUN apk add python3
java.useradd: RUN addgroup -S codepost && adduser -S -G codepost -h /home/codepost -s /bin/bash codepost
java.manifestInstall:
RUN apk add maven
COPY pom.xml /tmp/pom.xml
RUN mvn -f /tmp/pom.xml dependency:resolve

java-27.base:
FROM eclipse-temurin:27-jdk
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash make build-essential python3 maven
java-27.baseExtra:
COPY libs-pom.xml /tmp/libs-pom.xml
RUN mvn -f /tmp/libs-pom.xml dependency:copy-dependencies -DoutputDirectory=/opt/codepost/libs -q && rm -f /tmp/libs-pom.xml && chmod -R a+rX /opt/codepost

java-17.base:
FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jdk
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash make build-essential python3
java-17.manifestInstall:
RUN apt-get install -y maven
COPY pom.xml /tmp/pom.xml
RUN mvn -f /tmp/pom.xml dependency:resolve

java-11.base:
FROM eclipse-temurin:11-jdk
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash make build-essential python3
java-11.manifestInstall:
RUN apt-get install -y maven
COPY pom.xml /tmp/pom.xml

node-20.base:
FROM node:20-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash make build-essential python3
node-20.manifestInstall:
COPY package.json /tmp/package.json
RUN cd /tmp && npm install
ENV NODE_PATH=/tmp/node_modules

node-18.base:
FROM node:18-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash make build-essential python3
node-18.manifestInstall:
COPY package.json /tmp/package.json
RUN cd /tmp && npm install
ENV NODE_PATH=/tmp/node_modules

r-4.base:
FROM rocker/tidyverse:4.4.0
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash libpoppler-cpp-dev libtesseract-dev tesseract-ocr libleptonica-dev
r-4.manifestInstall:
COPY requirements.txt /tmp/requirements.txt
RUN R -e "pkgs <- readLines('/tmp/requirements.txt'); install.packages(pkgs, repos='https://cloud.r-project.org/', dependencies=TRUE, Ncpus=1); if (any(!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[,'Package'])) { quit(status=1) }"
